source_line: Sources: Forbes, NBC News, advisor.ca — Nov 20, 2026
caption:
The S&P 500 just fell 10.4% in a month. Friday alone it dropped 3.7% to a 7-month low, the Nasdaq fell 5.3%, and AI chipmaker Nvidia lost 12.4% in a single day. The Nasdaq erased its entire 2026 gain, and Canada's TSX fell too, dragged by the same AI names.

Here's why it's your money, not just Wall Street's: 401(k)s, RRSPs and index funds are packed with these exact stocks. When a handful of AI names drop, so does your retirement balance.

My take: a market this concentrated means everyone's nest egg rides on a few chipmakers — for better or worse.

Have you checked your 401(k) or TFSA this month?
